question.text: A PMS client has a 5-year liability of Rs. 2 crore. The PM invests in a 5-year AAA bond paying 8% coupon semi-annually and holds to maturity. Which passive strategy is this?

explanation.text: The Logic: Buy-and-Hold locks in yield at purchase, holds until maturity, and insulates against price risk. Reinvestment risk on coupons remains. The Trap: Indexing mirrors a benchmark, not a single bond. Immunization matches duration to liability; Barbell is an active strategy. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A treats the same concept; XXI-B expects PM-side reasoning. Manager's Pro-Tip: Buy-and-Hold works only when credit quality stays stable — that's why PMs pre-screen heavily on covenants and issuer financials before locking in.
